text: Assumption 1 . We suppose $F\left(\mathbf{x}_{1}\right)-\min_{\mathbf{x}\in\mathcal{X}}F(\mathbf{x})\leq\Delta_{F}$ for the initial point $\mathbf{x}_{1}$ . The feasible set $\mathcal{X}$ is closed and convex with bounded diameter, i.e., $\max_{\mathbf{x},\mathbf{y}\in\mathcal{X}}\left\|\mathbf{x}-\mathbf{y}\right\|\leq D$ .

Assumption 2 . All functions $f_{1},\dotsc,f_{K}$ are $L_{f}$ -Lipschitz continuous, and their Jacobians $\nabla f_{1},\dotsc,\nabla f_{K}$ are $L_{J}$ -Lipschitz continuous on the bounded domain $\mathcal{X}$ .

Assumption 4 . (Average smoothness and Lipschitz) For $1\leq i\leq K$ , we assume that: $\displaystyle\mathbb{E}_{\xi_{t}^{i}}\left[\left\|f_{i}(\mathbf{x};\xi_{t}^{i})-f_{i}(\mathbf{y};\xi_{t}^{i})\right\|^{2}\right]$ $\displaystyle\leq L_{f}^{2}\left\|\mathbf{x}-\mathbf{y}\right\|^{2},$ $\displaystyle\mathbb{E}_{\xi_{t}^{i}}\left[\left\|\nabla f_{i}(\mathbf{x};\xi_{t}^{i})-\nabla f_{i}(\mathbf{y};\xi_{t}^{i})\right\|^{2}\right]$ $\displaystyle\leq L_{J}^{2}\left\|\mathbf{x}-\mathbf{y}\right\|^{2}.$

Theorem 1 . Under Assumptions 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , PMVR-v1 enjoys the following guarantees: (i) By setting $B_{1}=\Omega(1)$ , $\eta=\Theta(\epsilon^{2})$ , and $\alpha=\Theta(\epsilon^{2})$ , we can ensure that $\mathbb{E}\left[\mathcal{F}(\mathbf{x}_{\tau})\right]\leq\epsilon$ within $\mathcal{O}(\epsilon^{-3})$ iterations. (ii) By setting $B_{1}=\Omega(\epsilon^{-1})$ , $\eta=\Theta(\epsilon)$ , and $\alpha=\Theta(\epsilon)$ , we can ensure that $\mathbb{E}\left[\mathcal{F}(\mathbf{x}_{\tau})\right]\leq\epsilon$ within $\mathcal{O}(\epsilon^{-2})$ iterations.

Theorem 2 . Under Assumptions 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , Stage-wise PMVR-v1 guarantees the following: (i) By setting $T_{s}=2^{s-1}$ , $B_{1}^{s}=1$ , and $\eta_{s}=\alpha_{s}=T_{s}^{-2/3}$ , we can ensure that $\mathbb{E}\left[\mathcal{F}(\mathbf{x}_{\tau})\right]\leq\epsilon$ within $\mathcal{O}(\epsilon^{-3})$ iterations. (ii) By setting $T_{s}=2^{s-1}$ , $B_{1}^{s}=\sqrt{T_{s}}$ , and $\eta_{s}=\alpha_{s}=T_{s}^{-1/2}$ , we can ensure $\mathbb{E}\left[\mathcal{F}(\mathbf{x}_{\tau})\right]\leq\epsilon$ within $\mathcal{O}(\epsilon^{-2})$ iterations.

Theorem 3 . Under Assumptions 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , our PMVR-v2 enjoys the following guarantees: (i) By setting $B_{1}=\Omega(1)$ , $N=\Omega(\epsilon^{-1})$ , $\eta=\Theta(\sqrt{\epsilon})$ , and $\alpha=\Theta(\epsilon)$ , we can ensure $\mathbb{E}\left[\mathcal{G}(\mathbf{x}_{\tau})\right]\leq\epsilon$ in $\mathcal{O}(\epsilon^{-1.5})$ iterations. (ii) By setting $B_{1}=\Omega(\epsilon^{-0.5})$ , $N=\Omega(\epsilon^{-1})$ , $\eta=\Theta(1)$ , and $\alpha=\Theta(\sqrt{\epsilon})$ , we can ensure $\mathbb{E}\left[\mathcal{G}(\mathbf{x}_{\tau})\right]\leq\epsilon$ in $\mathcal{O}(\epsilon^{-1})$ iterations.

Theorem 4 . Under Assumptions 1 , 2 , 3 , by setting $B_{1}=T$ , $\eta=T^{-1/2}$ , and $\alpha=1/2$ , our PMM-v1 algorithm ensures $\mathbb{E}\left[\mathcal{F}(\mathbf{x}_{\tau})\right]\leq\mathcal{O}(1/\sqrt{T})$ .

Theorem 5 . Under Assumptions 1 , 2 , 3 , by setting $B_{1}=N=T$ , $\eta=\Theta(1)$ , and $\alpha=1/2$ , our PMM-v2 algortithm can ensure $\mathbb{E}\left[\mathcal{G}(\mathbf{x}_{\tau})\right]\leq\mathcal{O}(1/T)$ .

Assumption 5 . A function $F:\mathcal{X}\mapsto\mathbb{R}$ is convex if $\displaystyle F(\mathbf{y})\geq F(\mathbf{x})+\langle\nabla F(\mathbf{x}),\mathbf{y}-\mathbf{x}\rangle,\quad\forall\mathbf{x},\mathbf{y}\in\mathcal{X}.$

Assumption 6 . A function $F:\mathcal{X}\mapsto\mathbb{R}$ is $\lambda$ -strongly convex if $\displaystyle F(\mathbf{y})\geq F(\mathbf{x})+\langle\nabla F(\mathbf{x}),\mathbf{y}-\mathbf{x}\rangle+\frac{\lambda}{2}\|\mathbf{y}-\mathbf{x}\|^{2},\quad\forall\mathbf{x},\mathbf{y}\in\mathcal{X}.$

Theorem 6 . For convex objectives, under Assumptions 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , Stage-wise PMVR-v1 enjoys the following guarantees: (i) By setting $B_{1}=\Omega(1)$ , $\eta_{s}=\Theta(\epsilon_{s}^{2})$ , $\alpha_{s}=\Theta(\epsilon_{s}^{2})$ , and $T_{s}=\Omega(\epsilon_{s}^{-2})$ , we can ensure that $\mathbb{E}\left[F(\mathbf{x}_{S})\right]-\min_{\hat{\mathbf{x}}}F(\hat{\mathbf{x}})\leq\epsilon$ in $\mathcal{O}(\epsilon^{-2})$ iterations. (ii) By setting $B_{1}=\Omega(\epsilon_{s}^{-1})$ , $\eta_{s}=\Theta(\epsilon_{s})$ , $\alpha_{s}=\Theta(\epsilon_{s})$ , and $T_{s}=\Omega(\epsilon_{s}^{-1})$ , we can ensure $\mathbb{E}\left[F(\mathbf{x}_{S})\right]-\min_{\hat{\mathbf{x}}}F(\hat{\mathbf{x}})\leq\epsilon$ in $\mathcal{O}(\epsilon^{-1})$ iterations.

Theorem 7 . For strongly convex objective functions, under Assumptions 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , our proposed Stage-wise PMVR-v2 algorithm enjoys the following guarantees: (i) Setting $B_{1}=\Omega(1)$ , $N=\Omega(\lambda\epsilon^{-1})$ , $\eta_{s}=\Theta(\lambda\epsilon_{s})$ , $\alpha_{s}=\Theta(\lambda\epsilon_{s})$ , and $T_{s}=\Omega(\lambda^{-1}\epsilon_{s}^{-1})$ , we ensure $\mathbb{E}\left[F(\mathbf{x}_{S})\right]-\min_{\hat{\mathbf{x}}}F(\hat{\mathbf{x}})\leq\epsilon$ in $S=\mathcal{O}(\log(\frac{\epsilon_{1}}{\epsilon}))$ stages. (ii) By setting $B_{1}=\Omega(\epsilon_{s}^{-1})$ , $N=\Omega(\lambda\epsilon^{-1})$ , $\eta_{s}=\Theta(\lambda)$ , $\alpha_{s}=\Theta(\lambda)$ , and $T_{s}=\Omega(\lambda^{-1})$ , we can ensure $\mathbb{E}\left[F(\mathbf{x}_{S})\right]-\min_{\hat{\mathbf{x}}}F(\hat{\mathbf{x}})\leq\epsilon$ within $S=\mathcal{O}(\log(\frac{\epsilon_{1}}{\epsilon}))$ stages.

Theorem 8 . Under Assumptions 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , our PMFS-v1 enjoys the following guarantees: (i) By setting $B_{1}=1$ , $I=m/B_{1}$ , $\alpha={B_{1}}/{m}$ and $\eta={m^{-1/4}T^{-1/2}}$ , we can ensure that $\mathbb{E}\left[\mathcal{F}(\mathbf{x}_{\tau})\right]\leq\epsilon$ within $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{m}\epsilon^{-2})$ iterations. (ii) By setting $B_{1}=\sqrt{m}$ , $I=m/B_{1}$ , $\alpha={B_{1}}/{m}$ and $\eta=T^{-1/2}$ , we can ensure that $\mathbb{E}\left[\mathcal{F}(\mathbf{x}_{\tau})\right]\leq\epsilon$ within $\mathcal{O}(\epsilon^{-2})$ iterations.

Theorem 9 . Under Assumptions 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , our PMFS-v2 enjoys the following guarantees: (i) By setting $B_{1}=\Omega(1)$ , $I=m/B_{1}$ , $N=\Omega(\epsilon^{-1})$ , $\eta=\Theta(1/\sqrt{m})$ , and $\alpha=\Theta(1/m)$ , we can ensure $\mathbb{E}\left[\mathcal{G}(\mathbf{x}_{\tau})\right]\leq\epsilon$ in $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{m}\epsilon^{-1})$ iterations. (ii) By setting $B_{1}=\Omega(\sqrt{m})$ , $I=m/B_{1}$ , $N=\Omega(\epsilon^{-1})$ , $\eta=\Theta(1)$ , and $\alpha=\Theta(1/\sqrt{m})$ , we can ensure $\mathbb{E}\left[\mathcal{G}(\mathbf{x}_{\tau})\right]\leq\epsilon$ in $\mathcal{O}(\epsilon^{-1})$ iterations.

Theorem 10 . For convex functions, under Assumptions 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , our Stage-wise PMFS-v1 enjoys the following guarantees: (i) Setting $B_{1}=\Omega(1)$ , $I=m/B_{1}$ , $\eta_{s}=\Theta(\epsilon_{s}/\sqrt{m})$ , $\alpha_{s}=\Theta(1/m)$ , and $T_{s}=\Omega(\sqrt{m}\epsilon_{s}^{-1})$ , we can ensure $\mathbb{E}\left[F(\mathbf{x}_{S})\right]-\min_{\hat{\mathbf{x}}}F(\hat{\mathbf{x}})\leq\epsilon$ in $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{m}\epsilon^{-1})$ iterations. (ii) By setting $B_{1}=\Omega(\sqrt{m})$ , $I=m/B_{1}$ , $\eta_{s}=\Theta(\epsilon_{s})$ , $\alpha_{s}=\Theta(1/\sqrt{m})$ , and $T_{s}=\Omega(\epsilon_{s}^{-1})$ , we can ensure $\mathbb{E}\left[F(\mathbf{x}_{S})\right]-\min_{\hat{\mathbf{x}}}F(\hat{\mathbf{x}})\leq\epsilon$ in $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{m}\epsilon^{-1})$ iterations.

Theorem 11 . For strongly convex function, under Assumptions 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , our proposed Stage-wise PMFS-v2 algorithm enjoys the following guarantees: (i) Setting $B_{1}=\Omega(1)$ , $I=m/B_{1}$ , $N=\Omega(\lambda\epsilon^{-1})$ , $\eta_{s}=\Theta(\lambda/\sqrt{m})$ , $\alpha_{s}=\Theta(1/m)$ , and $T_{s}=\Omega(\sqrt{m}/\lambda)$ , we ensure $\mathbb{E}\left[F(\mathbf{x}_{S})\right]-\min_{\hat{\mathbf{x}}}F(\hat{\mathbf{x}})\leq\epsilon$ in $\mathcal{O}(\log(\frac{\epsilon_{1}}{\epsilon}))$ stages. (ii) By setting $B_{1}=\Omega(\sqrt{m}/\lambda)$ , $I=m/B_{1}$ , $N=\Omega(\lambda\epsilon^{-1})$ , $\eta_{s}=\Theta(1)$ , $\alpha_{s}=\Theta(1/(\lambda\sqrt{m}))$ , and $T_{s}=\Omega(1)$ , we can ensure $\mathbb{E}\left[F(\mathbf{x}_{S})\right]-\min_{\hat{\mathbf{x}}}F(\hat{\mathbf{x}})\leq\epsilon$ within $\mathcal{O}(\log(\frac{\epsilon_{1}}{\epsilon}))$ stages.
